name: – After § 25 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text: 25c. Proposes the urgent convening of an international conference on disarmament, under the auspices of the UN, with a view to reversing the erosion of existing arms control frameworks and negotiating a new, legally binding multilateral framework; calls for the establishment of a permanent European Diplomatic Peace Corps, comprising highly trained, professional mediators specialising in preventive diplomacy and the non-violent resolution of conflicts, thereby endowing the EU with robust soft power instruments and effective, on-the-ground mediation capabilities;
